title: Comparison Constant Limit at One Half
statement: For each real number $\lambda$, define $C(\lambda)=e$ when $\lambda=1/2$, and $C(\lambda)=((1-\lambda)/\lambda)^{1/(2(1-2\lambda))}$ otherwise. As $\lambda$ approaches $1/2$ through values satisfying $0<\lambda<1/2$, $C(\lambda)$ tends to $e$.
hypotheses_covered: The parameter approaches $1/2$ within the open interval $(0,1/2)$
